cases.task: Choose the safe browser order for a named SSE event whose JSON payload is parseable but declares an unsupported application schema version.

required_facts.text: EventSource may accept lastEventId independently from application JSON.
A parseable named application frame with missing or unsupported schema_version is not trustworthy under the current protocol.
The dashboard must reject that parseable incompatible frame before changing its accepted application cursor or rendering evidence.
A payload that is not JSON at all remains separately labeled malformed after preserving the browser-accepted ID to avoid replay loops.
